title: Robust Asynchronous Planning via Auto-Formalization
abstract: arXiv:2606.00981v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLMs can plan by generating schedules directly as a Planner, or by translating a task into a formal specification for a solver as a Formalizer. Most real-world tasks are asynchronous, with non-uniform durations, concurrency, and execution-time changes, yet existing benchmarks hardly cover them. We unify asynchronous planning under one formulation and release three benchmarks spanning task-graph scale, grounded state and resource constraints, and execution-time events. Surprisingly, PDDL2.1, the formalism built for temporal planning, is the weakest pipeline. On AsyncPlan-XXL it averages 30.8% plan accuracy, against 81.7% for the Planner and 94.0% for a CP-SAT Formalizer. The gap widens with scale, and at 100 actions the three pipelines reach 9.0%, 44.5%, and 82.5%, respectively. The formalism is not to blame. translated_title: 通过自动形式化实现稳健的异步规划
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型可以通过两种方式进行规划：作为规划者直接生成调度方案，或作为形式化器将任务翻译成求解器可用的形式化规范。大多数现实世界的任务都是异步的，具有非均匀的持续时间、并发性以及执行时的变更，但现有基准测试几乎未涵盖这些情况。我们在统一的公式化框架下整合了异步规划，并发布了三个基准测试，涵盖任务图规模、基础状态与资源约束以及执行时事件。令人惊讶的是，专为时序规划而构建的形式化语言PDDL2.1却是最弱的流水线。在AsyncPlan-XXL上，其平均规划准确率仅为30.8%，而规划者方法达到81.7%，CP-SAT形式化器达到94.0%。这一差距随任务规模扩大而加剧，在100个动作时，三种流水线的准确率分别为9.0%、44.5%和82.5%。问题并不在于形式化语言本身——从同一个模型提取的中间表示编译而来，PDDL2.1和CP-SAT达到了几乎相同的准确率（81.6%对比……
tldr: 该论文统一了异步规划的公式化并发布三个新基准，发现LLM作为规划者或经CP-SAT形式化均可取得高准确率，而专为时序规划设计的PDDL2.1反而表现最差，且由于两者由同一中间表示编译时准确率几乎一致，瓶颈在于LLM对PDDL的自动生成而非形式化语言本身。
en_tdlr: The paper unifies asynchronous planning and introduces three benchmarks, showing that PDDL2.1—despite being designed for temporal planning—is the weakest LLM pipeline (30.8% accuracy on AsyncPlan-XXL vs. 81.7% for direct planning and 94.0% for CP-SAT formalization), and since both formalisms compiled from the same intermediate representation perform nearly identically, the bottleneck lies in LLM's PDDL generation rather than the formalism itself.
